verdicts.reason: A is a clean vertical stack with no collisions and a centred CTA, but the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker has moved from above the headline to below the body copy, which breaks the original reading order. The body copy also wraps to leave 'sparkling.' alone on its own line, and the top band is mostly empty. B is broken: the bottle sits right on top of the copy, cutting off the 'f' in 'off' and hiding the end of 'Every mixed case of Solstice sparkling', and the bottom third of the canvas is dead space under the CTA.
